Apple's cost of revenue (cost of sales) rose about 5.0% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025. I took these figures from memory of Apple's 10-K filings and did not search to confirm them.

- **Fiscal 2024:** cost of sales was about $210.35 billion.
- **Fiscal 2025:** net sales were about $416.16 billion and gross margin was about $195.20 billion. That puts cost of sales at about $220.96 billion.

The change is ($220.96B − $210.35B) / $210.35B, or about +5.04%.
